fy_rule: PE year Y is fiscal year Y-(Y+1): policyengine_uk/utils/parameters.py convert_to_fiscal_year_parameters sets every gov parameter for year Y to its 30 April Y value

extended_childcare_entitlement.documentation: The annual value of the working parent hours for the family's children, over and above their universal and targeted hours. See extended_childcare_entitlement_per_child.
extended_childcare_entitlement.label: annual extended childcare entitlement expenses

extended_childcare_entitlement_meets_inc.documentation: Whether this person expects at least the minimum income from work (SI 2022/1134 reg 18) and adjusted net income of no more than the limit (regs 14(3)(c)(i) and 15(3)(b)(i)).
extended_childcare_entitlement_meets_inc.label: Income eligible for the extended childcare entitlement

gov_spending.documentation: Government spending impact in respect of this household.
gov_spending.label: government spending

gov_tax.documentation: Government tax revenue impact in respect of this household.
gov_tax.label: government tax revenue

is_child.documentation: Deprecated: an age cut-off with no legal basis, kept only for downstream compatibility with its original formula. Nothing in policyengine-uk uses it. Use age_under_18 for the age band, is_hbai_dependent_child for HBAI statistics, or the programme's own child definition (for example is_child_or_qualifying_young_person_for_universal_credit) instead.
is_child.label: Aged under 18 (deprecated)

is_child_receiving_extended_childcare.documentation: Whether this child gets working parent hours beyond any universal or targeted hours it gets. A 3- or 4-year-old who gets the universal hours, in a family using no more than 15 hours a week, is on the universal entitlement only. Nobody receives it when the family's extended_childcare_entitlement is zero; a positive family amount supplied as an input, with no working parent hours calculated for any child, counts for every qualifying child of an eligible age.
is_child_receiving_extended_childcare.label: child is receiving extended childcare entitlement

max_free_entitlement_hours_used.documentation: The maximum weekly hours of free childcare entitlement used by the person
max_free_entitlement_hours_used.label: maximum hours of free childcare entitlement used

maximum_extended_childcare_hours_usage.documentation: The maximum number of weekly funded childcare hours this family uses for each child once eligible for the extended (working parent) entitlement. It caps the child's total funded hours, universal or targeted hours included. Those hours are never reduced below their own value, so for a child who gets them a limit under 15 adds no working parent hours rather than removing universal or targeted ones; a child without them, such as a 1-year-old, gets working parent hours up to the limit.
maximum_extended_childcare_hours_usage.label: maximum extended childcare hours used

targeted_childcare_entitlement.documentation: Targeted hours claimed on their own, or allocated first from a participating child's working parent hours when standalone take-up is false, as required by DfE guidance A1.11.
targeted_childcare_entitlement.label: targeted childcare entitlement amount

targeted_childcare_entitlement_eligible.documentation: Legal family eligibility, independent of standalone take-up.
targeted_childcare_entitlement_eligible.label: eligibility for targeted childcare entitlement

tax_free_childcare_meets_income_requirem.label: income eligible for the tax-free childcare

universal_childcare_entitlement.documentation: Universal hours claimed on their own, or allocated first from a participating child's working parent hours when standalone take-up is false. Legal eligibility determines this allocation.
universal_childcare_entitlement.label: universal childcare entitlement amount per year

universal_childcare_entitlement_eligible.documentation: Legal eligibility, independent of standalone take-up.
universal_childcare_entitlement_eligible.label: eligible for universal childcare entitlement

would_claim_extended_childcare.documentation: Whether this family would claim extended childcare entitlement if eligible
would_claim_extended_childcare.label: would claim extended childcare entitlement

would_claim_targeted_childcare.documentation: Whether this family would claim targeted childcare entitlement on its own if eligible. Working parent participation still allocates the child's first funded hours to targeted provision.
would_claim_targeted_childcare.label: would claim targeted childcare entitlement

would_claim_tfc.documentation: Whether this family would claim Tax-Free Childcare if eligible
would_claim_tfc.label: would claim Tax-Free Childcare

would_claim_universal_childcare.documentation: Whether this BenUnit would claim universal childcare entitlement on its own if eligible. Working parent participation still allocates the child's first funded hours to universal provision.
would_claim_universal_childcare.label: would claim universal childcare entitlement
